svg.title: The eight Kidwio buddies
svg.desc: Hazel the owl, Tully the turtle, Maple the fox, Rivet the robot, Mango the dragon, Pip the penguin, Coral the octopus, Clover the bunny
svg.text: 8 original characters · random at the start · switch any time

g.text: A wise little owl who loves big
A calm turtle who takes things one
A curious fox who always asks
A brave, gentle dragon who loves
A giggly penguin with a joke for
An arty octopus with eight arms
A kind bunny who loves nature,
